name: Graduation-cohort relative leader
hypothesis: Buy the highest predeclared liquidity-and-retention score among same-age graduates, holding a bounded intraday basket.
spec: Setup: Graduation quality may matter beyond simply reaching the threshold. Entry: Buy the highest predeclared liquidity-and-retention score among same-age graduates, holding a bounded intraday basket. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on score reversal, individual invalidation, or cohort horizon. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable.
